name: Abdominal crunch
description: Basic trunk flexion exercise for the abdominals.

name: Band lateral raise
description: Shoulder lateral raise using an elastic band.

name: Band pull-aparts
description: Band pull-aparts strengthen the rear shoulders and upper back.

name: Banded clamshell
description: Lie on your side with knees bent, feet together, and a resistance band above your knees. Open and lower the top knee while keeping your feet together. Repeat on the other side.

name: Banded hip abduction
description: Hip abduction against an elastic band.

name: Barbell row
description: Bent-over row for upper back and lats.

name: Bench press
description: Horizontal press performed lying on a bench.

name: Box step-up
description: Step onto a box or bench one leg at a time.

name: Bulgarian split squat
description: Rear-foot-elevated split squat for single-leg strength.

name: Chin-up
description: Vertical pull with an underhand grip.

name: Curl
description: Bend your elbows to lift the weight, then lower it slowly

name: Dead bug
description: Core control exercise with alternating arm and leg movement.

name: Deadlift
description: Hip hinge lift from the floor.

name: Dumbbell Side Bend
description: Hold a weight at your side, bend sideways, then return upright.

name: Dumbbell walking lunges
description: Walk forward while holding dumbbells, alternating legs and lowering into a lunge with each step.

name: Half-kneeling single-arm dumbbell press
description: Start in a half-kneeling position with one knee on a mat and the opposite foot flat on the floor. Hold a dumbbell at shoulder height with one hand, keep your torso tall, press it overhead, then lower with control. Record repetitions for one side, then repeat on the other side.

name: Hip thrust
description: Raise your hips from the floor by driving through your heels, then lower with control.

name: Jefferson curl
description: Slow loaded spinal flexion for hamstring and back mobility.

name: Lateral shoulder raise
description: Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height, then slowly lower them

name: Overhead press
description: Vertical press from shoulder level overhead.

name: Parallel bar support hold
description: Isometric support hold on dip bars.

name: Plank
description: Static core brace held in a straight line.

name: Pull-up
description: Vertical bodyweight pull from a bar.

name: Push-up
description: Horizontal bodyweight press from the floor.

name: Roman chair back extension
description: Position your hips on the pad, secure your feet, lower your torso by hinging at the hips, then raise your body back up in a controlled motion.

name: Squat
description: Lower-body squat with bodyweight or external load.

name: Suspension chest press
description: Lean forward holding the straps, then bend and extend your arms to push your body away, keeping your body straight.

name: Wall sit
description: Isometric squat hold against a wall.

name: Weighted dip
description: Parallel bar dip performed with added weight.
